request.body: {writerMessage:I hear you, but that clinical line is deliberate. Imogen manages grief as "arithmetic" - she intellectualizes to keep feeling at a survivable distance. So the abstract self-classification IS her voice at that peak moment: the prose enacts her retreat into taxonomy exactly when the emotion is strongest. That is the point, not a lapse in register. Make the case: why should I break that characterization rather than trust the reader to feel the coldness as hers?}
